name: Nadami Shouko
source:
Name: Shoko Nadami
Sex: Female
Age: 36 (Deceased)
Birthday: January 4
Profession: Investment Company Representative/Director.
Likes: To be envied and praised.
Dislikes: Someone who hurt her in the past.
Hobbies: Winery tours, Scandinavian furniture collection, Pilates.
Skills: Lying, Cheating.

Shoko Nadami is Renju's ex-wife, and a representative for a real estate investment company. On a Friday night in November, her body was found on the merry-go-round in the defunct amusement park known as "Bloom Park." Her left eye socket was hollowed out.

[Edited from the in-game character description]

[spoiler]In truth, Shoko has been deceased for over a year (dead at 35 years old), as she accidentally died after becoming a parasite within the body of Rohan Kumakura.[/spoiler]

Shoko makes an appearance in flashbacks during the events of the sequel.
